title: Zuckerberg Blames Team Structure For Llama 4's Failure, Says AI Models Needs Small, Tight-Knit Teams
key_facts: Zuckerberg said Llama 1 pioneered open-source AI, Llama 3 was nearly at the frontier, and Llama 4 'fell off the trajectory'.
He said he got 'the whole shape of the team' wrong, copying large Instagram and ads teams.
He now favours a very tight-knit team treating model building as a 'group science project'.
Meta built the new Meta Superintelligence Lab, unveiled in June 2025 under Alexandr Wang.
Meta says Muse Spark reaches Llama 4 Maverick-level capability with over ten times less compute.
Meta has signalled it will be more selective about open-sourcing models.
quote_evidence: "And then with Llama 4, we basically fell off the trajectory that we needed to be on."
"The whole shape of the team I had gotten wrong."
"Every seat on that team is extremely valuable."
why_it_matters_hint: Meta's CEO explains in his own words why Llama 4 fell short and what changed.
event_date: interview date not stated; Llama 4 launched earlier
notes: The interview's name and date are not given by OfficeChai. Muse Spark benchmark claims are Meta's. The article also reports an allegation by Yann LeCun, Meta's former chief scientist, about benchmark practices; not repeated here.
